label: IoT Sensor Simulator
info:
Generates one simulated sensor reading every second and POSTs it straight to the Express backend. No preprocessing happens here — Node-RED's only job is telemetry generation.

Flow:  inject (1s) -> function (generate) -> http request (POST /api/data) -> debug

All preprocessing (physics validation, buffering, missing-data detection, Hampel-filter outlier capping, one-minute aggregation, data-quality scoring) now runs server-side in server/preprocessing/ (see pipeline.js), triggered by every POST /api/data request.

NOTE on the http request node's URL:
- Running Node-RED NATIVELY (npx node-red / node-red, no container) -> use http://localhost:3000/...
- Running Node-RED INSIDE DOCKER (e.g. the official nodered/node-red image) -> 'localhost' means the container itself, not your host machine, so use http://host.docker.internal:3000/... instead (Docker Desktop's special DNS name for reaching the host).
